questions.q: In 'The Fox and the Grapes', what did the Fox say about the grapes after he could not reach them?
choices: They were sour and not worth it
They were the best grapes ever
questions.evidence: a bunch of sour grapes that are not worth gaping for

questions.q: What is the lesson of 'The Fox and the Grapes'?
choices: Some pretend to dislike what they cannot have
questions.evidence: pretend to despise and belittle that which is beyond their reach

questions.q: In 'The Bundle of Sticks', what happened when the Sons tried to break the sticks one at a time?
choices: The sticks bent but did not break

questions.q: What did the Father want to teach his Sons in 'The Bundle of Sticks'?
choices: The oldest son is the strongest

questions.q: In 'The Wolf and the Crane', why did the Wolf go to the Crane for help?
choices: Her long neck and bill could reach the bone in his throat
questions.evidence: with her long neck and bill, would easily be able to reach the bone

questions.q: In 'The Wolf and the Crane', what did the Wolf say the Crane's reward was?
choices: He let her take her head out of his mouth without biting it off
questions.evidence: Isn't it enough that I let you take your head out of my mouth without snapping it off?

questions.q: In 'The Ass and His Driver', what happened when the master let go of the Ass's tail?
choices: The Ass tumbled down the mountain side
The Ass walked safely to his stall
The Ass ran back up the hill
questions.evidence: the foolish Ass tumbled head over heels down the mountain side

questions.q: What is the lesson of 'The Oxen and the Wheels'?
choices: They complain most who suffer least
questions.evidence: They complain most who suffer least.
